notes: DriftPebble is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Drift Pebble (DPBL) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. Transfers are fee-free, and there are no subsequent mint, burn or administrative entry points. No application contracts are deployed. The pool pairs with IMD; initialPrice records provenance, while the opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
